Results.ReviewText:
Yes it's more pricey than many but it is solid and if cared for I believe it would last well beyond the 10 year warranty.
I have only had one minor problem since purchasing, it looks as if it is a design flaw.
The decorative clips that you put on the wheels to cover the axle and cotter pin are constantly popping off. As I move the grill, it looks as if the axle itself might be just a little too long. While moving, the axle seems to shift causing it to push on the inside of the decorative covers, popping them off.
When I say shift, I'm talking maybe 1/2" - 3/4", but that seems to be enough to make contact with the cover.
This certainly would not prevent me from buying this product.
It cooks evenly from right to left, and the actual grill surfaces are built for life.
I would refer this product to everyone and I'm extremely glad I spent time to research similar grills. 
After using it a dozen times or so, I now am convinced that I did in fact make the right decision in purchasing this grill.
Results.Title: As advertised.

Results.ReviewText:
I bought another Weber from The Home Depot in September 2019 after a great experience I had with a Spirit I 310 Natural Gas bought in 2016. I needed a BBQ for my summer property and I really wanted another Spirit I identical to the other model I have but it has been replaced by the Spirit II. 

This Spirit II has been a big letdown. The lid was dented in the box right from the factory, as seen in the picture below. The box was not damaged externally. As a result, a new BBQ looks like junk sitting on the deck. Then the fasteners and bracket provided/shown to mount the propane gas line to the bulkhead can't be mated - the captive nut that shows as part of the bracket doesn't exist and there was no supplementary nut provided that would otherwise perform that task. The third issue with this BBQ is that it heats unevenly. I'm not sure if it's because it's a propane model or not, but my Spirit I has excellent, even heat. This one hot spots in the center and leaves the sides and corners cool. 

All in all, I'm very unhappy with my Spirit II 310. Weber quality seemingly has gone downhill after just a few years. I would suggest looking elsewhere for your BBQ needs, as it appears I am not the only one to have purchased a factory damaged machine. I see there are other reviews showing damaged and missing hardware. 

Disappointed in Halifax.
Results.Title: Damaged In the Box, Quality Downhill
